hits.asked: Sochiye, garden ke chaaron taraf fencing lagani ho—humein andar ka area ya bahar ki boundary naapni hogi? Hear
hits.reply: Haan, rectangle ka perimeter 160 m hai: chaaron sides jodte hain. Ab length 50 m aur breadth 30 m ko jodkar dekhiye.

steps: Aapko rectangles, squares ya polygons mein se kaunsa shape pasand hai? → hook
